title: Hanna Chouest named a 2026 Railway Age Women in Rail honoree
body_markdown:
*Norfolk Southern leader recognized for her legal expertise, collaborative leadership, and commitment to developing others.*


For nearly two decades, Hanna Chouest has helped railroads navigate complex legal and regulatory issues. Now, her leadership, industry expertise, and commitment to developing others have earned her recognition as one of Railway Age’s 2026 Women in Rail honorees.


**Top 3 takeaways**


- **Recognized industry leader:** Hanna Chouest, Deputy General Counsel, Markets and Regulations, was named one of Railway Age’s 2026 Women in Rail honorees.
- **Nearly two decades of experience:** With about 17 years in rail law, Hanna Chouest serves as Norfolk Southern’s lead economic regulatory attorney, helping navigate complex regulatory matters, and supporting key business priorities.
- **Investing in others:** Her leadership extends beyond her legal work through mentoring colleagues, creating opportunities for others to grow, and three years of service on the Women in Norfolk Southern (WiNS) leadership team.


**Finding a path forward**


Hanna Chouest began advising Norfolk Southern and other rail clients as outside counsel in 2009 before joining the company in 2020. Today, as Deputy General Counsel, Markets and Regulations, she serves as Norfolk Southern’s lead economic regulatory attorney, supporting matters before the Surface Transportation Board and partnering with teams across the business.


Her work has supported major strategic initiatives, including Norfolk Southern’s $1.6 billion acquisition of the Cincinnati, New Orleans and Texas Pacific Railway and the Pan Am transaction. She also contributes her expertise to the broader rail industry through work with Association of American Railroads committees.


For Hanna Chouest, leadership is less about being the loudest voice in the room and more about bringing the right people and perspectives together.


“I don’t have to be the loudest voice in the room. For me, leadership is about making sure the right people are in the room, the right perspectives are being heard, and we’re working together toward the right solution.” - **Hanna Chouest, Deputy General Counsel, Markets and Regulations**


That collaborative approach carries into how Hanna Chouest works with teams across Norfolk Southern. She focuses first on understanding what the business is trying to accomplish, then works with colleagues to find a responsible path forward.


**Creating opportunities for others**


Hanna Chouest brings that same approach to developing the people around her. She served for three years on the WiNS leadership team and has been intentional about giving colleagues opportunities to lead projects, build experience, and receive recognition for their contributions.


Her selection as a 2026 Women in Rail honoree comes as Railway Age celebrates the 10th anniversary of the awards, recognizing women whose leadership and contributions are helping move the rail industry forward.


**Learn More**


Read more about Hanna Chouest and the other 2026 Women in Rail honorees in Railway Age’s November feature:[2026 Women in Rail Awards: 27 Women to Watch, Part 1 of 2](https://www.railwayage.com/news/railway-age-november-2026-digital-edition-spotlights-women-in-rail/)
